item.title: Colorado Parks and Wildlife Asking for Tips in Bald Eagle Shooting
item.description: Colorado Parks and Wildlife is investigating the shooting of a bald eagle in Northglenn. On January 12, CPW officers, Northglenn park rangers and Northglenn Animal Control officers responded to an eagle on the icy shoreline at Croke Reservoir, near W 104th Avenue and Huron Street. The raptor was safely captured and taken to a local wildlife rehabilitation facility for treatment.
